Optional engine follow-up, not required: in src/lang/ar/tap.ts cliticReading (line 159) the capital is triggered by bareNamesSet().has(stripHarakat(rest)), so any clitic + a homograph of a course name (حُسْن vs Hasan حَسَن) is capitalised; matching the vocalised form (nameIndex.has(rest)) only would prevent it, but that touches every clitic+name reading, so it needs its own re-export check.
verdicts.reason: Real. Confirmed cause: cliticReading capitalises the rest of a clitic word when its unvocalised skeleton حسن is in the course name list (Hasan), so ḥusn 'goodness' becomes Ḥusni. A hyphenated reading in the layer makes cliticReading return early (line 132: a reading that already has '-' is kept), so the one-word override is the safe, scoped fix; the reviewer's fix text gave only the output, not the mechanism.
